affected_component: Product draft delivery-authority projection across Studio, CLI, gateway and Codex drafters
invariant: After a human adopts and explicitly confirms a Core-admitted delivery topology, that exact typed value is the sole authority for input and output transport, cardinality, representation, network, credentials, lifecycle, runtime, browser and external-side-effect policy. A drafting model may propose task semantics and artifact implementation but cannot redefine those machine-owned facts. Unsupported confirmed topology still stops before any LLM, Coding Agent or repair call.
